_meta._73_note: EMPTY. Facet hubs slice the catalogue by verified attribute (free, PMR, dogs, duration). Across the 73's 30 fiches those fields are overwhelmingly null — the research found no source for PMR, dogs or journey time on most of them, and that is recorded on each fiche. A facet hub built on nulls would advertise a filter that returns nothing. Author these when the fields are filled, not before.
